title: target.toml
description: Describes the application under test. Lives at the root of the app repository. Contract: docs/contracts/target-toml.md.

version.description: Schema version of this file. Only 1 exists.

app.description: How to identify, start, stop and reach the app. Phase 1.

languages.description: Lowercase language names. Impact-analysis plugins: typescript, javascript, python, go, rust, csharp, php; any other name (java, kotlin, ...) falls back to the [areas] globs. Phase 2+.

start.description: Shell command run by `guard up`. Optional: without it guard up only waits for readiness.

stop.description: Shell command run by `guard down`. Optional: without it guard down is a no-op.

base_url.description: Local URL of the app, no trailing slash.

ready_path.description: guard waits for HTTP 200 at base_url + ready_path.

preview_url.description: Optional per-PR environment URL template; `{pr}` is replaced by the PR number.

services.description: Optional extra processes started by guard up after [app].start, in file order, and stopped by guard down in reverse order. TOML: [[services]]. Absent = single-process behavior. Names must be unique (checked by guard, not by this schema).

testability.description: The testability contract endpoints. Phase 1. The whole table is optional; every field has a default.

token_env.description: Name of the env var holding the test token, never the value.

areas.description: Business areas keyed by a snake_case identifier. At least one, at most 255.

hard_rules.description: Rules the decision engine can never override. Phase 3; parsed but unused in Phase 1.

blocked_domains.description: Host patterns aborted in every test. A leading `*.` matches any subdomain and the apex.

recorded_hosts.description: Hosts served from HAR recordings. Parsed in Phase 1, not yet enforced.

tracker.description: Issue tracker. Phase 2, except ticket_pattern, which guard test --affected already reads.

ticket_pattern.description: Regex (Rust `regex` syntax) matched against the branch name; the first match is the ticket key.

name.description: Unique service name; also the file stem under .guard/services/.

cwd.description: Repo-relative directory the commands run in. Forward slashes, no leading slash, no trailing slash, no segment starting with a dot (so no .. escapes).

start.description: Shell command run detached by guard up from cwd.

stop.description: Optional shell command run in the foreground by guard down before the recorded process tree is terminated.

ready_url.description: Optional. guard up waits for HTTP 200 here before starting the next service. Absent = do not wait.
